title: Tools
intro: Use CAIL's shared AI services for chat, media processing, research workflows, academic publishing, and direct model access.

sandbox.title: CAIL Sandbox
sandbox.description: Chat with a curated set of AI models in Open WebUI. Model-provider calls are configured for zero retention; conversations may still be saved in your Sandbox account.

tools.title: Multilingual Transcription Suite
tools.description: Generate transcripts from audio and video in dozens of languages, with optional translation and speaker identification.

tools.title: Image Description
tools.description: Create useful alt text and captions for images to support accessibility and digital publishing.

tools.title: Document OCR
tools.description: Extract searchable text from scans and PDFs, including difficult layouts and imperfect source images.

tools.title: Agent Studio
tools.description: Build research workflows that can search sources, inspect data, manage files, and produce drafts and visualizations.

tools.title: Site Studio
tools.description: Build portfolios, project sites, CV pages, and research documentation through a guided conversational workflow.

tools.title: Model Access
tools.description: Create, rotate, and revoke personal API keys, inspect available models, and review your model usage.

access.title: Need access?
access.description: CUNY faculty, staff, and students can request access or support through the Lab's application form.
